podcast.title: "Glue" of The Marvelettes
podcast.body: Juanita (Winnie Cowatt) was considered the "glue" that held the original Marvelettes group together, being a friend to all the other members. Her departure significantly impacted the group's internal cohesion. "Juanita and Georgiana had been the glue holding the group together. They'd been the ones who had been friends with all the others."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: American Bandstand Incident and Departure
podcast.body: Winnie Cowatt, also known as Juanita, experienced a severe breakdown and subsequently left The Marvelettes after a humiliating incident on "American Bandstand." She mistakenly stated that Detroit was a suburb of Inkster, leading to mockery that deeply affected her. "She felt so bad about this slip-up and the way she was mocked for it, so she had a breakdown and ended up leaving the group."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Exclusion from Motown Anniversaries
podcast.body: Winnie Cowatt was not invited to any of Motown's 25th, 40th, 50th, or 60th-anniversary celebrations, mirroring the lack of recognition for other original Marvelettes members. "None of the members of the first group to hit number one on the label were invited to be part of any of them."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
